request.style: English, folk duet, male and female vocals in harmony, acoustic guitars, mandolin, fiddle, upright bass, warm and steady, 96 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
By faith old Noah built an ark before the rain came down
By faith went Abraham from home across the unknown ground
By faith the people crossed the sea as if on solid land
By faith the walls of Jericho fell down at God's command

[Chorus]
Faith is the assurance of what we hope for
The conviction of what we do not see
Small as a mustard seed in my hand
But it rests on the One who carries me

[Verse]
The apostles said to the Lord, Give us more faith
And he spoke of the smallest seed a farmer ever sows
If you have faith like a mustard seed
You will say to this mountain, Move from here to there
And it will move
Nothing will be impossible for you

[Chorus]
Faith is the assurance of what we hope for
The conviction of what we do not see
Small as a mustard seed in my hand
But it rests on the One who carries me

[Bridge]
Without faith it is impossible to please him
For whoever comes to God must believe that he exists
And that he rewards those who seek him

[Chorus]
Faith is the assurance of what we hope for
The conviction of what we do not see
Small as a mustard seed in my hand
But it rests on the One who carries me

[Outro]
The conviction of what we do not see
